images.title: Close views of three woven baskets
images.purpose: Put the hook in front of the student before any word is said about weaving rules: three baskets, each with its own weaving pattern, so the question how to describe a pattern comes from looking.
images.composition: Three close views of woven baskets side by side on cream panels, each a block of crossing strips, with a plain caption under each.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP: the caption Close views of three woven baskets, centred at x 728 and y 90, in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (44 px). THREE SWATCHES side by side, each on a cream #F5E6C8 rounded panel (corner radius 14 px, thin dark #2B2B2B outline of 3 px) of 400 by 304 px with its top edge at y 200 and its left edge at x 58, 528 and 998, so the panels span x 58 to 458, 528 to 928 and 998 to 1398 (70 px between panels). Inside each panel there is a grid of exactly 8 columns by 6 rows of crossings, 48 crossings per panel, every crossing a 44 by 44 px cell with 4 px between cells; the grid starts 10 px inside the panel, so the cell at column c and row r (counted from 0 at the top left of the grid) has its top left corner at x panelLeft + 10 + 48c and y 210 + 48r. Every cell holds exactly one bar and nothing else: the letter A below is an AMBER #E69F00 horizontal rounded bar 44 px wide and 30 px high, centred in the cell (a strip that lies on top and runs across); the letter T below is a TEAL #0072B2 vertical rounded bar 30 px wide and 44 px high, centred in the cell (a strip that lies on top and runs up and down). Each bar has a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (2 px). Rows from the top, cells from the left. BASKET 1 (left panel): row 1 ATATATAT, row 2 TATATATA, row 3 ATATATAT, row 4 TATATATA, row 5 ATATATAT, row 6 TATATATA. BASKET 2 (middle panel): row 1 AATAATAA, row 2 TAATAATA, row 3 ATAATAAT, row 4 AATAATAA, row 5 TAATAATA, row 6 ATAATAAT. BASKET 3 (right panel): row 1 AAATTTAA, row 2 TAAATTTA, row 3 TTAAATTT, row 4 TTTAAATT, row 5 ATTTAAAT, row 6 AATTTAAA. Totals: Basket 1 has 24 amber bars and 24 teal bars, Basket 2 has 32 amber and 16 teal, Basket 3 has 24 amber and 24 teal, so 144 bars in all. UNDER each panel, centred under the panel at y 560, the captions Basket 1, Basket 2 and Basket 3 (40 px, dark #1F2937). No other text, no number and no arrow anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Each basket shows its own weaving pattern, made by strips that go over and under in a repeating way.
images.description: Three close views of woven baskets, each with a different pattern of horizontal and vertical strips lying on top.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, Weaving Mats. It follows the idea of the baskets in your maths book (a different weaving pattern on each basket) and describes nothing in words.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student look at each basket and say what is the same and what is different. Say no rule on this picture. The slip to watch: seeing a weave as a random mix of strips instead of a pattern that repeats.

image_decisions.why: The hook picture of three woven baskets shows the patterns the story asks the student to look at, without giving any rule.
